dataset.name: LongMemEval-S
dataset.question_types: human-authored, episodic memory, multi-hop, temporal reasoning

notes: M16-P0 gate result. 82% R@5 > 50% threshold → M17 Rama A open. Each question seeds a fresh in-memory SilvaDB from the haystack sessions — latency reflects per-query cold-start embedding (~30-60s per question on CPU, test ran with 60min timeout). Contrast: synthetic corpus queries (short descriptions) gave 50% R@5 — real human queries give 82%, confirming the pipeline is sound.
decision: M17 Rama A OPEN — OpenClaw + Hermes integration docs (v0.13.0)
